items.title: Ray Drummond interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: Trombone-led, like if you work with Steve Turre for instance, the timbre is different.

ctx.x: Well is it different playing behind—

The texture. The texture is different. Saxophone player, that’s a reed. When you have a bar that’s vibrating that’s different. If the guy out in front is like Ron Carter playing his piccolo bass that’s a different timbre. I’ve done those. I’ve played with Ron as the bass player and it’s fun. I enjoyed it. But it’s different.
